relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results show that CXCL12 and CXCR4 levels increased significantly in morphine-tolerant rats and were reduced by AM1241 pretreatment, which was reversed by AM630.

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, low-dose AM1241 attenuates morphine tolerance in cases of cancer pain by inhibiting CXCL12 and CXCR4 expression.

relationships.subject: CXCL12
relationships.evidence_quote: CXCL12/CXCR4 expression accelerated the development of morphine tolerance and downregulated MOR expression.

relationships.subject: CXCL12
relationships.evidence_quote: Co-administration of CXCL12-Ab or AMD3100 with morphine increased MOR mRNA expression in both the spinal cord and DRG, while co-administration of exogenous CXCL12 with morphine decreased MOR mRNA expression in both the spinal cord and DRG compared with that in the MV group (Fig. 4C).

key_findings: Non-analgesic dose of CB2 agonist AM1241 reduced CXCL12/CXCR4 and attenuated morphine tolerance in Walker 256 rats.
CXCL12/CXCR4 signaling promoted morphine tolerance and MOR downregulation; CXCR4 colocalized with CB2 and MOR.
